title: Back to School Interviews with 6th Graders
article:
As the school year begins, Senesh welcomes many new students. For some kids changing schools can be hard and for others it can be a fun change.

When new kids come to Senesh, they have a similar experience, a bunch of kind welcoming friends. Ella Getz, a new 6th grader said, “I love the people here so much and it is very welcoming!” Sabine Shulimovich,another new 6th grader, agreed with her, “I feel so welcomed by everyone!”

We always get a lot of new students in sixth grade, so we asked some kids for their experience during the second week of school.

“ I love Sensh so much!” said Emmie Edry.

“It has been welcoming to me!” said Rachel Genel.

On top of asking about her overall experience, we asked RubyPliner-Bloom how she was handling a new scene, “It’s pretty chill” she said.

We also asked some returning students how the school year has gone for them. “I’ve been here for years and this school year has been good so far!” Shaya Levine told us. “All the new kids are so kind and sweet! I’m so happy they came!” Lilly Blecker exclaimed. It seems like a lot of the old students are happy with this school year, too.

After doing our interviews and research, we think that most students in sixth grade, returning and new, are happy with this new school year and they are excited to be part of the next generation at Senesh.
author: Simone Zizmor, Sabine Shulimovich and Ruby Pliner-Bloom
